labels.label: ersprop:PropLocUniqueness
labels.notes: Not marked, row partial. I diffed the elaborated binders against the originals. ers_prop_4_63_globallyHyperbolicOn_secondCountable and IsCommonDevelopment.globallyHyperbolicOn_secondCountable equal their originals less hext, plus [SecondCountableTopology M], and the conclusions are identical. The four union lemmas also lose only hext. eq_of_mem and of_subset take T1 + SC where the originals had no separation axiom. sSup and sSup_of_pieces take T2 + SC. CausallyArcConnectedOn U₁ stays named and the REPORT calls it 'strengthened'. The docstring calls ers_prop_4_63_of_hasTimeFunction 'subsumed' (:144). That holds only on second countable M, which is this module's setting: the original asks no SC.

labels.label: ersthm:ThmUnique
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. The binder diff for each of the three trade forms (_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_, _maxCommonDevelopment_, _of_localUniqueness_) shows exactly -hacausal -hsplit +hC₁ : C.IsCauchySurfaceOn U₁ S +harc : C.CausallyArcConnectedOn U₁ +[SecondCountableTopology M], with identical conclusions. The docstring (:51-53) and the REPORT call these forms siblings, 'not stronger', which is correct: on SC spaces hC₁ ∧ harc implies hacausal ∧ hsplit. A proper witness exists (U₂ = ]-1,1[).

labels.label: ersrem:RemTime
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. ers_remark_4_67_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_secondCountable has the same trade as 4.64. ers_remark_4_67_globallyHyperbolicOn_secondCountable is the original less hacausal, hsplit and hext. All three are discharged from the original's own hS (C, U₁) and hC, so the kb/0218 condition holds. That form really is stronger than the original on SC spaces, as the REPORT says. The future/past _secondCountable forms drop only hthrough. The future/past _of_isCauchySurfaceOn_ forms drop hacausal and hthrough and add harc, keeping the original's hC₁. Jplus/Jminus_inter_subset_…_of_t1_secondCountable are the originals with T2 replaced by T1 + SC and without hthrough, with identical conclusions and new direct proofs. All four forms are exercised by the timelikeLine witness.

labels.label: erscor:CorDisCon
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. Both trade forms show -hacausal -hsplit +hC₁ +harc +SC, with identical conclusions. There is no witness: it would need a disconnected overlap, and the original has none either. The REPORT discloses this, but the module SCOPE does not (finding 5).

labels.label: erscor:globally_defined_globally_hyperbolic
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. ers_corollary_4_69_secondCountable is the original less hthrough₂. ers_corollary_4_69_of_isCauchySurface_secondCountable shows -hacausal -hsplit -hthrough₂ +hC₁ : C.IsCauchySurface S +harc : C.CausallyArcConnected. I checked the observation for the author against the Lean, and it says what is claimed. isPreconnected_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_of_t1_secondCountable is: [T1Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] {W} {D : Causality M} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hSW : S ⊆ W) (hC : D.IsCauchySurfaceOn W S) : IsPreconnected W. So U₂ is (pre)connected from S preconnected and Cauchy in U₂, for any causality, with no timelike field. It is presented as an observation, not a defect, which is correct: the paper gives no proof of 4.69.

labels.label: erslem:LemConnected
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. Both forms are the originals less hthrough (∀ x ∈ U₁ ⊓ U₂, ∃ I γ, Cτ.Inextensible ⊤ I γ ∧ x ∈ γ '' I), discharged by inextensibleThrough_of_t1_secondCountable Cτ ⊤. honce, hn₁, hn₂ and hτ are carried unchanged (OQ-41 (b)). A proper witness exists. Ladder consequence: programme/ladder.toml:2656 with witness at :2659, as the REPORT says.

labels.label: erscor:CorSupLum
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. ers_corollary_4_71_secondCountable is the original less hsplit and hthroughτ. hsplit comes from the original's own hC₁ : C.IsCauchySurfaceOn U₁ S, so kb/0218 is satisfied. The trade form further shows -hacausal +harc. Neither form has a witness, and the original has none.

labels.label: ersthm:ThmNotBlocking
labels.notes: Not marked, partial. This is the optional item. ers_theorem_4_82_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_secondCountable shows -hsplit : ∀ i, (cau i).SplitBy (dom i) S +hcauchy : ∀ i, (cau i).IsCauchySurfaceOn (dom i) S +SC, with an identical conclusion.
